{{Top|leg}}
'''Bonion''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] leader on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Obinipor]]. On [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], Obinipor was neutral to the ongoing [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] intended to force the planet in joining him by having one of his [[Starship/Legends|ships]], the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']], fly two of its [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] and buzz Obinipor's largest corporate headquarters.<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>
